visuals.heading: Do This Week

items.text: Each row is one real notice.
Exams reward a clear plan more than a long wish list.
You can sit six kinds of graduate-level exam with a BA in history.
The order follows how much you can build beside or after the job, then the pay ceiling.
What earns trust Degree and B.Ed marks, a teacher eligibility test where the notice asks for one, then the test stages in the notice.

blocks.heading: Order Your Exams By Age Limit

items.text: Most history graduates plan around the exam they want most.
Upper age for the general category in the notices checked, before relaxations for reserved categories and other groups.
The practical sequence: sit the low-limit exams early while they are still open to you, and keep UPSC and your state PSC for the longer window.
Answer the four questions to see whether this route can fit your life, then pass the three proofs to show you can do its work, before any fee leaves your account.
A tehsil office, a bank branch, a railway shift and a classroom are very different days.
Preparation years bring no salary, and a first attempt may not succeed.
Choose one route from each group, read its newest notice end to end, and note the age limit, the degree rule and the post count.
Try it now: Take the free employability skills test to check the skills you can build beside the exam route.
If you want a second opinion on which exam to sit first, career counselling for government jobs is where we start.
